findings.title: reviews/csr ctor_ab citation (W3 E=15400, 239.9 ms -> 1.96 ms best-of-5) has no committed raw artifact
findings.detail: The numbers appear only inside reviews/csr/review.json ('per amendment record'). The committed csr_microbench.json instead shows E=15334: 258.95 ms -> 0.486 ms and E=62023: 3237.7 ms -> 1.968 ms (bit_equal true), so the 1.96 ms figure coincides with the E=62023 row, not the cited E=15400 run. The citation is unreproducible from committed evidence alone.
findings.impact: None on the decision: construction-speed evidence of record is the committed, independently recomputed stage_model engine_ctor (245.4 ms -> 2.24 ms) plus csr_microbench.json; the kernel-only numbers are corroborative context, and BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL forbids promoting kernel-only speed anyway.
findings.recommendation: Cite csr_microbench.json (committed raw) instead of the uncommitted ctor_ab run, or commit the ctor_ab raw output.
